instructions: You are one of six decision makers. In each of 15 paid periods, urn A or urn B is selected with equal probability. Urn A contains two light balls and one dark ball; urn B contains one light ball and two dark balls. Each participant privately sees one draw, with the ball replaced after every draw. Participants decide in a newly randomized order. Before deciding, you observe all predictions announced earlier in that period, but not the private draws that produced them. Predict urn A or urn B. After all six decisions, the true urn is revealed. A correct prediction earns $2 and an incorrect prediction earns $0.

items.question: Which urn do you predict was selected?
